name: io.drint/driglass
title: Driglass
description: Sizes, print zones and screen counts for printing straight on glass bottles and drinking glasses.

tools.name: list_containers
tools.description: The glass bottles (12 oz long neck, stubby, 500 ml Vichy, Bordeaux and Burgundy 750 ml) and drinking glasses (16 oz pint, 16 oz can glass, 9 oz rocks) Driglass makes, with outside diameter and height, brim-full volume, finish (crown or cork), where the size comes from, and the zones that can take a print.

kind.description: Only bottles, or only drinking glasses (tumbler). Leave out for all.

tools.name: print_spec
tools.description: For one container, its glass colour and the inks: the art size of each print zone (body; neck where there is one; crown cap top), the neck unrolled to its arc (inner and outer radius, angle), the screens needed (one per ink, plus white under on coloured glass or for read-through art), and the rules for screen printing on glass. Returns a link that opens the same container in Driglass.

glass.description: Glass colour: flint (clear), amber, green, antique (antique green) or cobalt. Defaults to flint.

inks.description: The ink colours printed, e.g. ["red", "gold"]. White is counted on its own; precious metal (gold, silver, platinum) is a separate firing. Defaults to one ink.

white_under.description: Print white under the colours (they look dark on coloured glass without it, and art read through clear glass needs it). Defaults to true on coloured glass, false on flint.

cap.description: Crown cap colour on crown-finish bottles. Defaults to gold.
